item.observed: Two rapid commands render as user A, user B, reply A, reply B.
item.title: Shoppers see queued commands before the reply to their previous message — queued user bubbles append immediately while replies append at the end

item.observed: Clicking Try on within 1.2 seconds starts a second request while the first is pending.
item.title: Shoppers clicking Try on after selecting gear launch two paid previews — the automatic timer is not cancelled when manual generation starts

item.observed: Editing the profile during the first generation cancels it and schedules no new preview.
item.title: Shoppers editing measurements during their first preview can lose the result without a replacement — cancelling leaves the already-null render key unchanged

item.observed: POST /api/fitting-room/assistant with {} or an empty message returns 422, not a reply.
item.title: Marketplace integrators receive validation errors instead of an assistant reply for empty requests — the request model requires a nonempty message

item.observed: A queued turn sends the previous filters and style_note immediately after a stylist update.
item.title: Shoppers' queued follow-up reaches the stylist with old filters and mood — the next request starts before React commits the preceding result

item.observed: A failed automatic regeneration leaves the old outfit image visible.
item.title: Shoppers can still see removed gear after a preview update fails — the automatic regeneration keeps the previous image displayed

item.observed: A pre-edit saved look is marked current after selecting it under new measurements.
item.title: Shoppers can restore a model with old body proportions after editing measurements — saved looks and render keys do not include the profile

item.observed: Switching 171 cm to feet and back changes the height to 170 cm.
item.title: Shoppers can lose a centimetre and receive incorrect fit results just by switching height units — conversion rounds to whole inches and overwrites the original value

item.observed: A no-op stylist reply cancels an in-flight preview and schedules another.
item.title: Shoppers can wait through repeated paid previews when the stylist makes no outfit change — every reply creates a new equipped object that restarts the generation effect

item.observed: Anonymous clients can repeatedly call both paid AI endpoints without a usage limit.
item.title: The operator can incur uncontrolled model charges from anonymous traffic — both paid AI routes lack any rate, quota or abuse guard

item.observed: A generated image is accepted without checking selected pieces or extra gear.
item.title: Shoppers can be shown unlisted gear and missing selected pieces as a successful try-on — provider images are returned without checking the rendered contents

item.observed: The image prompt calls for a black base layer or the selfie clothing, neither a listing.
item.title: Shoppers can see clothing with no corresponding selected listing — the try-on prompt explicitly preserves selfie clothes or adds a black base layer

item.observed: POST /tryon accepts profile=null and generates without body measurements.
item.title: Marketplace clients can create a model without required measurements — try-on still accepts an absent profile

item.observed: fits_only is ignored and product responses contain no fit boolean.
item.title: Marketplace integrators cannot reliably request all gear or its fit status — product endpoints ignore fits_only and never return a fit boolean

item.observed: Sold-out listings can be equipped but /tryon then rejects them with 409.
item.title: Shoppers can select sold-out gear and then lose their try-on — the catalog and equip controls do not enforce in_stock

item.observed: Catalog cards omit lengths and the circlet still has length_cm=null.
item.title: Shoppers cannot compare item lengths from the catalog and one listing has no length anywhere — cards omit length and the circlet seed leaves it empty

item.observed: Valid in-stock IDs are accepted even when they violate the requested color or budget.
item.title: Stylist recommendations can violate the shopper's color or budget — response cleanup checks only whether IDs exist, not whether they match the request

item.observed: A model object with no reply is returned as the successful text 'Done.'.
item.title: Shoppers see a false stylist success when the model supplies no answer — missing reply text is replaced with 'Done.' instead of an error

item.observed: The reply can name nonexistent or sold-out items even when action IDs are filtered.
item.title: Shoppers can receive nonexistent or sold-out recommendations — only action IDs are checked while the assistant's free-text reply is displayed unchanged

item.observed: A highlighted helmet remains absent when an existing cloak category filter stays active.
item.title: Shoppers cannot find a suggested listing in the catalog grid — recommendations do not clear or reconcile filters that hide highlighted items

item.observed: The 409 toast lists raw item IDs, not the names or affected selection rows.
item.title: Shoppers cannot readily identify the outfit piece blocking a preview — the 409 error exposes catalog IDs instead of marking and naming selected items

item.observed: Clear all immediately deletes the worn and set-aside selection without confirmation.
item.title: Shoppers can lose an entire carefully assembled selection with one click — Clear all deletes worn and set-aside items without confirmation or undo

item.observed: Switching off fit-only retains the automatically selected gender filter.
item.title: Shoppers turning off the fit filter still cannot see all catalog gear — the automatically applied gender filter remains active

item.observed: A stylist reply requested under the old profile is applied after the profile changes.
item.title: Shoppers can receive unfitting gear after updating their measurements — in-flight stylist results are applied without checking the current profile

item.observed: A string max_price is accepted from the model and can make product filtering return 422.
item.title: Shoppers can lose catalog filtering after a malformed stylist reply — filter values are accepted as arbitrary strings rather than checked against each field's type

item.observed: A model reply with clear_all="false" clears the entire selection.
item.title: Shoppers can lose their selected outfit on a malformed stylist reply — coercing the string "false" with bool makes clear_all true

item.observed: The refactored decoder still accepts unbounded image data and arbitrary image formats.
item.title: Invalid selfie payloads can reach paid generation — try-on decodes any image bytes without checking the data-URL format or size

item.observed: An unrestricted large image is decoded and resized synchronously on the event loop.
item.title: A visitor's very large selfie can stall other shoppers' requests — unrestricted image decoding and resizing block the server event loop

item.observed: Product images are still fetched one at a time with a 20-second timeout each.
item.title: Shoppers with a full outfit can time out before image generation starts — product images are fetched serially with a separate 20-second timeout each

item.observed: Product and assistant catalog reads still stop at 1000 records with no next page.
item.title: Shoppers cannot find later catalog items once the marketplace grows past 1000 products — all catalog and stylist reads are capped without pagination

item.observed: price ASC and gender/color/aesthetic + price indexes are absent from product reads.
item.title: Catalog and stylist requests slow as marketplace products accumulate — price-sorted and attribute-filter reads lack matching indexes

item.observed: Image fetch errors and missing model configuration escape the provider error handlers.
item.title: Shoppers get an unhandled server error when a gear image fails or the model key is missing — setup occurs outside the provider error handlers

item.observed: Backend model calls have no deadline after the browser times out.
item.title: Timed-out AI requests can continue consuming server resources and provider credits after shoppers retry — model calls have no backend deadline

item.observed: Invalid returned image data is rendered without validation or an image error fallback.
item.title: Shoppers can see a broken preview instead of an error — generated image data is neither decoded and validated nor given a load-error fallback

item.observed: Repeated /tryon POSTs independently start paid renders without an idempotency key.
item.title: Duplicate try-on requests can charge the operator twice — the anonymous generation endpoint has no idempotency or in-flight deduplication

item.observed: A late assistant equip replaces a newer manually selected item in the same category.
item.title: A shopper's newer wardrobe choice can be set aside when an older stylist reply arrives — late equip operations overwrite the current category

item.observed: The sizing min/max range query has no sizing-field index.
item.title: Fit-filtered catalog requests slow as marketplace listings grow — the new height and weight range query has no sizing index and scans products

item.observed: Only a single form-level message identifies invalid measurements.
item.title: Shoppers do not see which measurement fields are required or errors beside them — the dialog has only a single form-level message

item.observed: Saved measurements are shown in centimetres and kilograms regardless of entry units.
item.title: Shoppers cannot review their measurements in their chosen units — the profile discards unit preferences and the tag always uses metric

item.observed: Cancel closes the required measurements dialog and discards the new selfie.
item.title: Shoppers can accidentally discard a new selfie before entering measurements — the required dialog can be dismissed instead of keeping the user in the form

item.observed: Changing A → B → A lets B's in-flight image replace A before another request runs.
item.title: Shoppers can see an intermediate outfit after reverting to their saved look — the equal-render-key branch exits before invalidating the in-flight request

item.observed: Editing measurements or reusing the same photo can cancel generation without a retry.
item.title: Shoppers editing measurements or reusing their photo during the first preview can lose it without a replacement — cancellation leaves the already-null render key and selfie unchanged

item.observed: After the first unfiltered catalog request fails, later grid loads do not update byId.
item.title: Shoppers' stylist choices silently stop working after a temporary catalog error — the ID lookup is never retried even if the visible grid later loads

item.observed: A failed initial facets request leaves all filter options empty without retry.
item.title: Shoppers lose catalog filter options after a temporary facets error — the initial request suppresses errors and has no retry

item.observed: The maximum-price slider still moves in $5 increments.
item.title: Budget shoppers cannot select exact price limits — the maximum-price filter only allows $5 increments

item.observed: With max_price=0 and no other filter, Reset filters is hidden.
item.title: Shoppers cannot use Reset after a zero-price stylist filter — the active-filter check treats zero as inactive

item.observed: Hold for original has pointer handlers only; keyboard activation does not compare.
item.title: Keyboard users cannot compare their generated look with the original selfie — the compare button only handles pointer events

item.observed: New photo opens file upload only, with no option to reopen the camera.
item.title: Shoppers cannot retake a camera selfie in the fitting room — the replacement control only opens file upload

item.observed: The refactored product constructor still sets in_stock=true for every sample item.
item.title: The demo cannot exercise sold-out marketplace listings — every sample item is seeded in stock

item.observed: GET /api/fitting-room/products?min_price= returns 422 instead of unfiltered products.
item.title: Marketplace clients cannot leave numeric catalog filters blank — FastAPI parses empty strings as invalid floats before the query builder can ignore them

item.observed: At narrow widths, the ft/in inputs and fixed 112px unit toggle exceed the dialog width.
item.title: Phone shoppers can lose access to the imperial height fields — two full-width number inputs and a fixed-width toggle share an unwrapping row without min-width relief

item.observed: An equip ID returned as a string is discarded while the stylist reply is shown as success.
item.title: Shoppers can be told an item was equipped when nothing changed — malformed action fields are silently converted to empty arrays

item.observed: Every distinct product image URL remains in the process-wide base64 cache indefinitely.
item.title: Shoppers can experience slowdowns or failed previews as marketplace listings grow — the product image cache has no size limit or eviction

item.observed: Missing sizing index: min_height_cm, max_height_cm, min_weight_kg, max_weight_kg.
item.title: Fit-filtered catalog requests slow as marketplace listings grow — the new height and weight range query has no sizing index and scans products

item.observed: A message over 1000 characters receives only 'The Quartermaster is away. Try again.'.
item.title: Shoppers cannot tell why a long stylist request is rejected — the input has no length limit and validation errors are reported as an unavailable assistant

item.observed: backend/.env omits the model key read by both paid AI endpoints.
item.title: Shoppers cannot generate previews or use the stylist with the supplied backend environment — both model helpers require an undefined key unless it is injected externally

item.observed: A null max_price from the stylist is dropped, leaving the existing price limit active.
item.title: Shoppers cannot remove an existing catalog filter by voice or chat — the stylist treats null as unchanged and response cleanup discards it before merging

item.observed: Queued stylist requests continue to be sent after the fitting room unmounts.
item.title: The operator can be charged for abandoned stylist commands after a shopper leaves — the queue has no unmount cancellation and keeps dispatching requests

item.observed: A FileReader error produces no message and never opens the measurements form.
item.title: Shoppers get no feedback when the browser cannot read their chosen photo — the file reader has no error or abort handler
